notes.title: Music-themed JRPG Shining Resonance Refrain out now
notes.content:
It might have been over ten years since anything was officially localised, but it’s nice to see Shining Resonance Refrain released today on PC, bringing us a very belated return (of sorts) to Sega’s old Shining series of JRPGs. While Shining Resonance first launched back in 2014 as one of the PlayStation 3’s later games in Japan, Sega have decided to bless all current platforms – including ours – with this slightly expanded remastering of the game.

(more…)

notes.title: Shining Resonance Refrain is live! - 10 JULY 2018
notes.content:
Hello Shining Resonance fans!

We are pleased to announce that Shining Resonance Refrain is now live on Steam!

We hope you enjoy this exciting RPG adventure featuring character designs from renowned artist Tony Taka.

Liberate the dragon's soul that resides within you!

Enjoy,
SEGA Dev

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Shining Resonance Refrain
notes.content:
Shining Resonance Refrain is Now Available on Steam!

Play as Yuma Ilvern and stop the Empire from exploiting the power of the ancient dragons, including the soul of the Shining Dragon within you. With the help of your friends, realize your destiny, save Astoria, and unleash the strength you’ve always had locked away.
